Every recitation and every spoken translation, ayah by ayah, plus the full-Surah reciters drawn from all the providers behind one catalogue. Both adhan catalogues are served here too, though the recordings themselves ship inside the app so they can sound from a notification. Kept audio for a verse-by-verse reciter is the one thing still fetched whole from the Islamic Network CDN.

Prayer times, the Hijri date, the Ramadan timetable, and the 604-page Mushaf layout with the Juz and Hizb divisions — kept with the app rather than asked for, so a page of the Quran opens without a connection. Every adhan recording is stored here too, eighteen for the day and two for dawn, which is what lets the call sound at Fajr with no network at all. The sun does not need the internet, and nothing about where you are is sent anywhere.

Quran text, prayer times, hadith, the Names, supplications and the countdown to Hajj come from api.islamicdata.uz. Recitation audio comes from cdn.islamic.network. The adhan recordings you choose are downloaded from audio.islamicdata.uz. Gold and silver prices used by the Zakat calculator come from misc.islamicdata.uz. Each of these receives the request needed to answer it and nothing about you.
